summary: The purpose of this report is to seek instruction for an Ontario Municipal Board Hearing on the above-noted matter. The hearing is scheduled to commence on April 16, 2018.
decided: City Council on March 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. Council adopt the confidential recommendations in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 16, 2018) from the City Solicitor. 2. City Council authorize the public release of the confidential recommendations in Confidential Attachment 1 and Confidential Appendices A and B to the report (March 16, 2018) from the City Solicitor and City Council direct that the balance of Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 16, 2018) from the City Solicitor remain confidential. The confidential recommendations in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (March 16, 2018) from the City Solicitor were adopted by City Council and are now public, as follows: 1.
